description: CCP-5 Coordination Mechanism Negotiation vectors (spec/02a-tdma.md). Tests priority order: SCHEDULED > HASH_BASED > ANNOUNCE_DRIVEN > FALLBACK. Uses lichen_coordination_mechanism enum values from link.h:165-170. Independent of ccp9*.json content-layer tests; this file tests the mechanism SELECTION logic.

vectors.name: priority_scheduled_wins_all
vectors.description: SCHEDULED mechanism wins when TDMA slot is assigned, even with known peer, announce channel, and SFN available. Priority 1 (highest).

vectors.name: priority_hash_wins_over_announce
vectors.description: HASH_BASED mechanism wins when peer is known and SFN is available, even with announce channel present. Priority 2.

vectors.name: priority_announce_wins_over_fallback
vectors.description: ANNOUNCE_DRIVEN mechanism wins when announce channel present and peer known but no SFN (so hash tier skipped). Receiving an Announce implies the peer is known. Priority 3.

vectors.name: priority_fallback_when_nothing_available
vectors.description: FALLBACK to CH0 when no TDMA slot, unknown peer, no announce channel. Priority 4 (lowest).

vectors.name: hash_requires_peer_known
vectors.description: HASH_BASED requires peer_known=true; unknown peer with SFN still falls through to FALLBACK.

vectors.name: hash_requires_sfn
vectors.description: HASH_BASED requires SFN; known peer without SFN falls through to announce or fallback.

vectors.name: enum_wire_mapping
vectors.description: Coordination mechanism enum values match link.h:157-162 and wire strings. MUST be bit-identical across implementations.

vectors.name: priority_chain_exhaustive
vectors.description: Full priority chain: each tier blocks lower tiers. Implementations MUST check in order: SCHEDULED -> HASH -> ANNOUNCE -> FALLBACK. Note: has_announce=true implies peer_known=true (you cannot have an announce from an unknown peer).

expected.description: Each test_case.expected_mechanism is the sole valid outcome for that input combination.
